content_data.meeting_title: Visual Identity & Asset Optimization for Cost Reduction Initiative
agenda_items: Align on key visual KPIs for cost-reduction success
Discuss impact of proposed design changes on user experience and brand perception
Review current visual assets and identify areas for consolidation/simplification
Brainstorm creative solutions for reducing asset production costs without compromising brand quality
key_decisions: Conduct A/B testing on simplified visual elements to gauge player reception before full implementation.
Investigate procedural generation techniques for certain in-game assets to reduce manual labor.
action_items: Product Manager: Provide data on player engagement with current visual assets to inform design decisions within the next 5 days.
Creative Designer (Persona): Develop a concept presentation showcasing proposed visual asset consolidation strategies by next week.

memory_deletes.removed_item: Prioritize repurposing existing high-quality assets over creating new ones for initial phases.
Art Director: Schedule a workshop with 3D artists to explore procedural generation tools within the next two weeks.
